title: Exercise With or Without Electrical Stimulation in Cystic Fibrosis (Part I): Effects on Physical Fitness
brief_summary: This study aims to assess the effects of programmed exercise with or without electrical stimulation in the cardiorespiratory fitness, strength, functional capacity and agility in a group of young patients with Cystic Fibrosis: A randomized controlled trial comparing two interventions with a control group.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of CF
* Age: 6-18 years old
* Signature of informed consent of legal guardian and patient.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Being a smoker
* Having had an exacerbation in the last 3 months
* Having undergone gastric surgery
* Having enteral nutrition at present
* The patients will come from the HIUNJ of Madrid.
* Currently taking CFTR modulators
